_purpose: Verified starting point for WRAPPER and LOCAL-TEST launcher configs (#2121). The SHIPPED config is launcher/launcher.json (image mode, version-pinned by make sync-versions); this example is a dockerfile-mode config for running a second, isolated instance from a repo checkout. The wiring keys below are pinned against the shipped config by backend/tests/test_launcher_example_config.py - if they drift, make test goes red.
_wiring_trap: env_port_key MUST be ADAPTIVE_LEARNER_PUBLIC_PORT - the launcher default APP_PORT silently configures nothing (the 0.21.x field-session finding this file exists for).
_isolation_note: container_name / compose_project / image_name / config_dir / volume carry a -local suffix so a test instance never collides with the real installation's containers or MOUNTS ITS DATA. The real install's volume is the PREFIXED adaptive-learner_adaptive-learner-data (#2154) - never point a test config at it. Since #2122 the compose path is isolatable too: set ADAPTIVE_LEARNER_CONTAINER_NAME / ADAPTIVE_LEARNER_IMAGE_NAME / COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME to the same -local values in .env and docker-compose.prod.yml resolves a fully separate identity.
